items.title: Christine Jensen interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, March 4, 2024
items.q: I’ve always been very interested in American literature actually, or more current American literature like Jonathan Franzen. I love his descriptions of society in general

ctx.x: So sometimes I guess I do reflections and sometimes I’m doing — or reflections from childhood and other times I’m doing reflections of something very recent. Or I might be imagining something I’ve never done so there’s no rhyme or reason to titles sometimes. But fantasy is a big part of it for me. I’ll send you my new liner notes of my new album because it’s all about what we’re talking about. And one of the things is that I start my liner notes saying I’ve always had my nose in a book and — or my family always…
descriptions of society in general so I might just sit and — I’ve written pieces about his books and his place with emotion.
